notes: SR81 Graham and Green (UK), Magento 2, direct HTTP fetch throughout, no blocks. Nav mega-menu has a 'New In' section with a top 'New Arrivals' overview link (https://www.grahamandgreen.co.uk/new-arrivals, which 301-redirects to the canonical https://www.grahamandgreen.co.uk/new-arrivals/view-all-new-arrivals - same listing, not double counted) plus 9 genuine per-department 'New In X' children, all real paginated Magento category grids (verified breadcrumb/H1 on each), not marketing/lookbook pages - captured as parent + children per the brief's grouping-row rule. Note: unlike the Clearance/'Last Chance' section on this same site (where department totals summed exactly to the parent total), here the 9 department totals sum to 884, well above the parent 'View All New Arrivals' total of 487 - the view-all listing is evidently a curated/capped cross-department feed rather than a strict union of the department pages (487 is close to just Furniture+Home Accessories+Lighting+Mirrors+Soft Furnishings = 489, suggesting Rugs/Gifts/Clothing & Accessories/Christmas are excluded from the 'view all' feed but each is still its own genuine, separately-linked New Arrivals PLP). Recorded all of them as separate rows per the brief's 'genuinely different listings, different counts -> keep both' rule rather than trying to force a reconciliation. All counts via exhaustion method (unique product-price tile IDs deduped across all pages using the rendered toolbar page count, plus one page fetched past the end to confirm zero tiles).
